mapper.sql: id, phone, password_hash, nickname, openid, family_id, role, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users(phone, password_hash, nickname, openid, family_id, role, created_at) VALUES(#{phone}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{openid}, #{familyId}, #{role}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET phone=#{phone}, password_hash=#{passwordHash}, nickname=#{nickname}, openid=#{openid}, family_id=#{familyId}, role=#{role} WHERE id=#{id}
